# Network360 Core Team

With this release, the Network360 Core Team is excited to include the enhancements and fixes in *Compare Networks* (e.g. performance improvements and the ability to compare networks based on provider attributes), *Adequacy* (e.g. updated HSD template exports to facilitate clients' compliance efforts), and other modules.

# Enhancements

### Adequacy

* The available exports now include the Provider HSD Template and Facility HSD Template.  These exports enable clients to download standardized data outputs that are compliant with CMS standards.  

### Compare Networks

###### Custom Attributes

* Now, users can compare networks based on provider and provider location attributes.

  * To include attributes in your analysis criteria, click on the “Show attribute options” link.  
  * Then the attribute selection fields will appear. First, the user will select their desired attribute category (e.g., access, cost, quality, etc.) The available attributes associated with that category will display, and the user can select their desired specific criteria. (Note: the available attributes will depend on the attributes contained within the selected project’s data.)
  * The user’s attribute selection will be applied to all Compare Network results and exports.

###### Confirmed Practicing

* Now when the analysis criteria includes confirmed practicing, the results display all four quadrants, their related detail pages, and exports.  In the past, the results included only two quadrants. 
* Now in the pdf exports, the analysis criteria displays on the second page instead of the cover page.  

###### Network Strength Quadrant

* ![Network Strength quadrant title dropdown ](/cms/cms-assets/media/network-strength-group-by-dropdown.png "Network Strength quadrant title dropdown")
* ![Network Strength quadrant group by options](/cms/cms-assets/media/network-strength-group-by-options.png "Network Strength quadrant group by options")
* This quadrant’s title is now “Top Network Strength by.” This was previously titled “Network Strength (Largest Provider Populations).
* Now, the user can choose how to display the results by selecting an option in the dropdown list within the quadrant’s title. 

  * The results can be displayed as a list or map and grouped by geographic type (zip code, county, or state). 
  * The available options in the dropdown may be limited by the selected geography in the analysis criteria. For example, a radius search may be grouped only by zip code.

# Fixes

### Compare Networks

* Fixed a rare issue where the detail results lists were not filtered by both the provider type and specialty group and thus the detail results did not match the Comparison Results. This issue occurred only when a specialty group was mapped to multiple provider types. 
* Fixed an issue where the star ratings did not appear in the Network Strength quadrant.  Now, the star ratings will appear.  However, when no geography is selected, the Network Strength quadrant will not include the link to view details.

### Competitive Dashboard

* Now, when a datetime attribute is selected as part of the analysis criteria, the results will display correctly in the CSV export and match the results in the UI. 

### Create a List

* Now, when a datetime attribute is selected as part of the analysis criteria, the results will display correctly in the CSV export and match the results in the UI. 

### Welcome Tour

* Fixed an issue where the welcome tour disappeared before getting to the last step.  Now the full tour displays.
